newsitem.title: USA: Low premium seen in U.S. Mint nickel tender.
newsitem.headline: Low premium seen in U.S. Mint nickel tender.

text.p: Considar, the New York based trading company, will come out the winner in the U.S. Mint tender for 220 tonnes of nickel, traders said.
Some dealers were surprised that Considar had offered material at a premium over LME cash of about 7.5 cents per pound.
This is sharply down from the 10 to 14 cents per pound quoted by several traders in the current U.S. physical market.
Five companies offered material to the U.S. Mint, Considar, Hochschild Partners, BenMet, Phoenixx International and Oxbow.
